title: Enforce BR-001 in the domain layer
description: The order grand total must equal subtotal plus tax minus discount. The UI must render the server-computed amounts rather than recomputing them client-side.
acceptance: given an Order with subtotal, tax and discount, when the summary renders, then total equals subtotal + tax - discount
given a missing amounts object, when the order renders, then a safe placeholder is shown

title: Enforce BR-002 in the domain layer
description: Tax is computed by the billing service at the prevailing rate on (subtotal minus discount); the UI never calculates tax itself.
acceptance: given any order, when displayed, then the tax value shown is exactly the value from the contract payload

title: Enforce BR-003 in the domain layer
description: Allowed transitions are pending -> paid -> shipped -> delivered. An order may be cancelled only from pending or paid. Any other transition is rejected.
acceptance: given a pending order, when acting on it, then only paid and cancelled are offered
given a delivered order, when acting on it, then no transitions are offered
given an unknown status value, when rendering, then a fallback badge is shown without crashing

title: Enforce BR-004 in the domain layer
description: A discount may be applied only when the linked customer's tier is `gold` or `platinum`; silver and bronze customers are ineligible.
acceptance: given a silver customer, when an operator tries a discount, then the action is blocked with a rule reference
given a gold customer, when a discount is applied, then amounts.discount is reflected in the total

title: Enforce BR-005 in the domain layer
description: All monetary values are expressed using an ISO 4217 currency code; `USD` is the default when the backend omits the field. Money is formatted with that code.
acceptance: given currency USD, when totals render, then they use USD currency formatting
given a missing currency, when totals render, then USD is assumed

title: Delete dummy data module /home/user/contract-harness/examples/lovable-app/src/data/mock-orders.ts
description: Remove the mock module and any re-exports once every consuming component reads live data. Search the repo for the const names to confirm zero references.
acceptance: No import of /home/user/contract-harness/examples/lovable-app/src/data/mock-orders.ts remains; production build succeeds.

title: Contract, rule and visual verification
description: Run the full verification sweep: contract tests against recorded fixtures, business-rule tests with violation cases, and visual QA of loading/empty/error states on every migrated screen.
acceptance: All contract tests pass against target fixtures.
Every business rule has at least one happy-path and one violation test.
No dummy data references remain in the codebase.
Migrated screens verified for loading, empty and error states.
